description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison between two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different tasks or systems: “Struct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” as evaluated on the MMAR benchmark for deep reasoning in audio modalities. The vertical y-axis represents “Accuracy (%)” ranging from 10 to 70 in increments of 10, while the horizontal x-axis lists the three systems in order from left to right. Each system has two adjacent bars: a blue bar for MMAU and a purple bar for MMAR, as indicated by the legend in the top-left corner. For “Struct,” MMAU achieves approximately 53% accuracy while MMAR reaches around 40%. For “Audio-Reasoner,” MMAU scores roughly 73%, significantly outperforming MMAR at about 60%. In the “Qwen-2.5-Omni” category, MMAU again leads with approximately 78% accuracy, compared to MMAR’s ~72%. The chart is tilted slightly clockwise, giving it a 3D perspective, and all bars are solid-colored with no patterns or error bars. The overall trend shows MMAU consistently outperforming MMAR across all three evaluated systems.
